messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — long-context requests (>=16k tokens) increased 3.1x week-over-week in eu-west1. Dashboard: https://redwood/infracap/ctx-growth  
ajay: Oof. Do we have GPU‑hour estimates if this trend continues? Any short wins?  
lucy: Ran a quick back-of-envelope. If 16k+ streaming stays, monthly GPU hours for streaming on the p4d fleet jump ~45%. Rough calc and assumptions in the sheet.  
ajay: Can we avoid full scale by shifting noncritical streams to lower-res models or batching?  
maria: Proposed mitigations: 1) prebake warm pools to keep KV caches hot, 2) route non-streaming long-context to a batch queue (5–15s latency), 3) enable quantized variants on dedicated where quality allows. Need risk + cost numbers.  
ops-bot: deploy scheduled: warm-pool-provision at 2026-03-25T02:00Z  
taylor: Sketch for warm-pool rotation (to limit preemptible churn and preserve cache):  
``` 
warm_pool_size: 12  # per region
rotation_per_day: 3
prewarm_hours: 2
cache_retention: 6h
``` 
lucy: Cost delta estimate: warm pools add ~\$18k/month per EU region vs ~\$76k/month if we naively scale fleet. Net savings ~\$58k/month per region if we avoid full scale. Numbers in spreadsheet.  
maria: Networking constraint — eu-west1 inter-region peering currently at 3Gbps cap; streaming growth will hit that and cause cross-region fallback. We need either egress re-route or L4 LB tweaks.  
ajay: Can we compress streams (proto v2) to cut bandwidth ~40%? Local tests looked promising.  
lucy: Also flagged that autoscaler doesn’t account for KV cache warm time; after scale-up effective capacity << raw GPUs for first ~10min. We should model warm ramp in forecasts and cost calc.  
ops-bot: incident logged: 1767894442 - EU stream tail latency spike — auto failed over to us-central.  
maria: Seen the incident, that’s why warm pools + cross-region fallback are both important. Failover without warm caches hurts latency.  
taylor: Action items summarized:  
- @eng-infra: finalise warm-pool rollout plan by Fri
- @eng-runtime: add warm_latency factor to autoscaler sim
- @finance: approve regional warm-pool spend estimate  
lucy: Uploaded the spreadsheet with scenario runs and sensitivity to 20/40/60% long-context tails: https://redwood/sheets/warm-pool-eu  
ajay: One more ops idea — run low-priority batch windows overnight (02:00–06:00 local) to soak noninteractive long-context jobs and shave peak. Could reduce peak GPU hours ~10–15%.  
maria: Good suggestion. Let's sync tomorrow 10:30am to lock plan. :thumbsup:
